tc.research_page.REVIVAL_ASPECT_RELATION:
Middle-click an aspect, or type ~ followed by its name, to find directly related aspects. The result includes the target itself.

A click is confirmed when the middle button is released; dragging does not also trigger a search. Connection assistance is a separate research.
tc.research_page.REVIVAL_LISTENING_GUIDA:
Direct prerequisites on the same Thaumonomicon page that are currently researchable are shown for free. Left-click to locate the first one. Once these are satisfied, left-click research that is still locked to listen for guidance, including hidden research temporarily located from JEI. Pay one point per initial note aspect, or one point per secondary-research cost aspect, up to three.

Guidance follows unavailable research prerequisites until it finds research you can pursue, or a condition such as scanning an aspect, item or creature, or experiencing warp. Each research keeps one unfinished clue. Left-click a research clue to locate it; other conditions cannot be followed. Complete the condition before listening again. Indirect prerequisites show their depth: a prerequisite of a direct prerequisite is depth 2.

JEI shows completed prerequisites, researchable direct prerequisites on the same page and your current clue. Other unfinished conditions remain unknown.
tc.research_page.REVIVAL_RESEARCH_ASSIST:
You can now search ordinary aspect names at the research table. Opt into auto refill to learn completed notes and replenish paper and ink from your inventory. Random research still requires its normal materials and prerequisites.

Wheel and number-key controls are basic operations, independent of this research. Each assistance feature can be configured separately.
tc.research_page.REVIVAL_RESEARCH_CONNEC:
The Primordial Pearl suggests a way to organize complex aspect relations into paths. Hold and drag the middle button across research notes to preview a connection; release it to place aspects one at a time under the normal rules.

You still need known aspects, sufficient research points and legal free cells. No research or resource costs are bypassed. Disabled earlier assistance stages do not prevent this stage from being reached.

thaumcraft.research.shortcuts.help: Wheel or arrows select a column. Keys 1–5 select a row; press the same key again to cancel. Left-click places once and clears the selection; invalid clicks keep it. Dragging takes priority. Right-click erases a placed aspect on the note and clears the search. Middle-click a known aspect in the list to search related aspects. Hold and drag the middle mouse button over the note to preview an automatic connection; release to place it. Negative cells cannot be filled. Typing a letter or ~ while unfocused clears the old query and starts a new search. Space or right-click clears both search and aspect selection. Clearing search restores the previous column. Esc closes; E does not. When disabled, search, clearing, original dragging and paging remain, while column highlighting and row labels are hidden.
